description: Search 25karats' in-stock IGI/GIA-certified lab-grown loose diamonds (center stones for engagement rings) by shape, carat, color, clarity, cut, and price. Values outside the grading scales (an unknown shape, color, clarity, grade, or lab, or a min above its max) return an error listing the accepted values; an empty result means no stones match. Prices are the live customer price in USD. Each stone includes certificate details, measurements, and image/video links when available. The site has no pairing step: the shopper adds the stone and a ring setting to the cart separately, and calls 800-201-3404 to confirm the stone fits the setting.

clarity.description: One clarity or an array: FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, SI1, SI2, I1, I2, I3

color.description: One color or an array; D through K

cut.description: Cut grade as a label or certificate code: 'Ideal' (ID) or 'Excellent' (EX)

lab.description: Grading lab: IGI, GIA, GCAL, HRD, or AGS

limit.description: Results per page (default 24); values outside 1..50 are clamped and reported

page.description: Page number; values below 1 are clamped and reported

polish.description: Polish grade as a label or certificate code: 'Excellent' (EX), 'Very Good' (VG), 'Good' (GD)

shape.description: One shape or an array: Round, Princess, Emerald, Marquise, Asscher, Oval, Pear, Heart, Cushion, Radiant

stock_no.description: Exact stone lookup by stock number

symmetry.description: Symmetry grade as a label or certificate code: 'Excellent' (EX) or 'Very Good' (VG)

name: search_diamonds
